Agent1 is excited about the opportunity to attend the concert but is also suspicious of the legitimacy of the tickets due to the low price. Agent2, on the other hand, is eager to sell the tickets quickly but is aware of the skepticism their offer might raise.
learner_goal: Secure the purchase of the concert tickets from Agent2 while ensuring their authenticity and addressing any potential legal concerns (<extra_info>Extra information: Agent1 is eager to attend the concert but wants to avoid any legal issues that might arise from purchasing potentially illegitimate tickets.</extra_info>)
